title: Kendini Anlatmak
goalTr: Nereli olduğunu, işini, hobilerini KALIPLARLA anlat — tek tek kelimelerle değil. Sonra topu karşıya at.

chunks.en: I'm originally from ___.
I'm from ___ but I live in ___.
I recently graduated from ___.
I run a small business.
chunks.ex: I run a small business back in Turkey.

chunks.en: I work mostly on ___.
I'm into ___.
chunks.use: Hobi anlatmanın EN doğal yolu. 'I like'tan daha havalı.

chunks.en: I've been getting into ___.
chunks.ex: I've been getting into surfing lately.

chunks.en: I've always been interested in ___.
I spend a lot of time ___.
chunks.use: -ing ile: 'I spend a lot of time taking photos.'

chunks.en: I've been doing it for ___ years.
I'm trying to get better at ___.
I came here mostly to relax.
I wanted to experience something different.
This is actually my first time in Indonesia.
I've traveled around Europe before.
I went to the US last year.
How did you get into that?
chunks.use: Karşı tarafın hobisine EN iyi takip sorusu.
chunks.ex: I'm into diving. — Oh cool, how did you get into that?

chunks.en: How long have you been doing that?
What do you do back home?
I'm here with a friend.

quick.sample: I run a small business back in Turkey.
I'm into photography — and football, of course.

quick.q: Why did you come to Bali?
quick.sample: I wanted to experience something different.

quick.q: How long have you been doing your job?
quick.sample: I've been doing it for about five years.
Mostly, yeah. It's busy but I like it.

quick.q: What do you do in your free time?
quick.sample: I spend a lot of time taking photos.
No, I'm here with a friend.
A bit — I've traveled around Europe before.
Istanbul? Huge, crowded, but amazing food.

social.stmt: I quit my job to travel for a year.
samples: No way, that's brave! How's it going so far?
That's amazing. What made you decide to do it?
Oh cool! How long have you been doing that?
That sounds like a dream job, honestly.
Oh wow — what year are you in?
How's that going? It sounds intense.

social.stmt: I do a bit of photography.
samples: Nice! What do you usually shoot?
Oh cool, can I see some of your photos?

social.stmt: I'm from a small town in Norway.
samples: Nice — do you miss it when you travel?

social.stmt: I've been working online while traveling.
samples: Oh nice! I've thought about that too. What kind of work do you do?
Same here! I can't stop eating nasi goreng. What's been your favorite?

social.stmt: Kendini 30 saniyede tanıt: nereli olduğun, işin, neye meraklı olduğun, neden Bali'ye geldiğin.
samples: I run a... / I work mostly on...

grammar.title: Deneyim anlatma: went / I've been / I've been staying

intro.ex: I went to the US last year. (belirli zaman → went)
I've been to Thailand. (deneyim, zaman yok)
I've been staying in Ubud for three days. (hâlâ sürüyor)

drills.best: I went to the US last year.
I've been staying in Ubud for three days.
I've never been to Indonesia before — this is my first time.
How did you get into that?

listening.audio: So what do you do back home?
I've been getting into photography lately.

scenario.title: Kafede Sohbet
scenario.situationTr: Canggu'da bir kafede çalışan/dinlenen bir gezginle sohbete başladınız. Konu: işler, hobiler, Bali'ye geliş sebepleri.
scenario.goalTr: Kalıplarla kendini anlat (I'm into... / I run... / I came here to...) ve 'How did you get into that?' ile karşıyı konuştur.

beats.ai: Is this seat taken? ... Thanks! I'm {name}. Crazy busy café today, huh?
beats.tr: Bu koltuk dolu mu? ... Sağ ol! Ben {name}. Kafe bugün çok kalabalık, değil mi?
beats.sample: No, go ahead! I'm Hakan. Yeah, it's packed!

beats.ai: So are you working here too, or just chilling?
beats.tr: Sen de mi çalışıyorsun, yoksa takılıyor musun?
beats.sample: Just chilling, honestly. I'm on holiday.

beats.ai: Nice! I'm doing {doing} while traveling. What do you do back home?
beats.tr: Güzel! Ben seyahat ederken {doing} yapıyorum. Sen memlekette ne iş yapıyorsun?
beats.sample: I run a small business back in Turkey.

beats.ai: Oh cool. How long have you been doing that?
beats.sample: I've been doing it for about five years.

beats.ai: Nice. And outside work — what are you into?
beats.tr: Güzel. Peki iş dışında — nelere meraklısın?
beats.sample: I'm into photography. And football, of course.

beats.ai: Oh really? I'm into {into} myself. How did you get into it?
beats.tr: Öyle mi? Ben de {into} meraklısıyım. Sen buna nasıl merak sardın?
beats.sample: I started a few years ago, just with my phone.

beats.ai: That's how it always starts, haha. So why Bali? What made you pick it?
beats.tr: Hep öyle başlar zaten, haha. Peki neden Bali? Ne seçtirdi?
beats.sample: I wanted to experience something different. And it's beautiful!

beats.ai: Fair enough. Have you tried the food here yet? The warungs are amazing.
beats.tr: Anlaşılır. Buranın yemeklerini denedin mi? Warunglar harika.
beats.sample: A little bit. What would you recommend?

beats.ai: You should try nasi campur. There's a great warung near here, actually.
beats.tr: Nasi campur denemelisin. Yakında harika bir warung var aslında.
beats.sample: Oh nice, I'm down to try it. Where is it?

beats.ai: Two minutes away. I'm heading there for lunch — wanna join?
beats.tr: İki dakika mesafede. Öğlen oraya gideceğim — gelmek ister misin?
beats.sample: Sure, sounds good! Let's do it.
